EESIC trains environmental engineers for sustainability challenges with an international-cooperation lens, jointly managed by a consortium anchored in Trento. For the 2027-2029 intake applications are already open, with deadlines of 30 June 2027 (non-EU) and 31 July 2027 (EU) — much later than most Erasmus Mundus rounds.

Programme Highlights

  • Late deadlines: 30 June 2027 (non-EU) and 31 July 2027 (EU)
  • EUR 1,400 monthly scholarships with tuition coverage for scholarship holders
  • Cooperation-focused engineering curriculum for global sustainability problems
  • Fee schedule transparent: EUR 8,000 per year for non-scholarship students

Who Should Apply

Environmental, civil, chemical and energy engineering graduates interested in sustainability and development contexts fit the programme well.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships of EUR 1,400 per month for selected students; participation costs for scholarship holders are covered.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the EESIC admission page; contact the consortium at the official address for scholarship eligibility questions. Key deadline information: 30 June 2027 for non-EU students; 31 July 2027 for EU students (2027-2029 intake — applications already open).

Official Source

  • Official application page (verified link)

About EESIC Consortium

The EESIC consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Engineering for Environmental Sustainability and International Cooperation, with a coordination office in Trento and European partner universities.

Official website: https://eesic.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 30 June 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
